scope: Targetless RPG.GameCore.SetModifierDynamicValue payloads with exactly DynamicKey, ModifierName and NewValue.
selected_model: Resolve the callback ModifierOwnerEntity, require exactly one ALIVE ModifierInstance whose name equals ModifierName, evaluate NewValue through the existing DynamicValue evaluator, then immutably overwrite only that instance's dynamic_values[DynamicKey]. Preserve all other local values and instance order. The operation does not write DynamicValueStore.
ordering: The local overwrite is visible to the next sequential sibling after this operation. Pending and dirty-removed instances are not candidates, so the selected model does not cross the lifecycle activation/removal boundary.

evidence.support: MCommon_Windfury_SkillNoNeed OnBeforeSkillCost mutates MCommon_Windfury._AssistEnergyNeedOnce through a targetless ModifierName/DynamicKey/NewValue payload.
MAvatar_BlackSwan_00_DOT OnPhase1 uses the same targetless overwrite shape for MAvatar_BlackSwan_00_DOT_Enhance.MDF_Count.
Modifier lifecycle distinguishes ALIVE from pending and dirty-removal states.
NewValue is evaluated by the selected immutable DynamicValue reference evaluator.
A real MCommon_Windfury component executes through BehaviorCompiler and SemanticExecutor.

strict_rejection: ModifyFunction=Add or any extra source argument
zero or multiple matching ALIVE instances
general cross-entity lookup or merge semantics
unsupported_boundary: native lookup identity beyond selected owner/name/ALIVE model
full Windfury and Black Swan callback semantics
dsh_implementation_contract: Keep ModifierInstance-local DynamicValues separate from the battle-level DynamicValueStore. For the selected targetless overwrite shape, resolve the owning entity from callback context and update only an unambiguous active named instance. Do not auto-activate pending instances, select a stack by position, or infer Add/merge behavior.
